sloka: सा तु शोक परीत अंगी मैथिली जनकात्मजा ।राक्षसी वशम् आपन्ना व्याघ्रीणाम् हरिणी यथा ॥३-५६-३४॥
transliteration: sā tu śoka parīta aṁgī maithilī janakātmajā ।rākṣasī vaśam āpannā vyāghrīṇām hariṇī yathā ॥3-56-34॥

translations.english: Sita, daughter of Janaka, engulfed in grief found herself like a doe under the control of tigresses.
